item.title: Ontario issues RFP for Highway 17 twinning between Renfrew & Arnprior
item.description: RENFREW — The long-awaited expansion of Highway (Hwy.) 17 between Arnprior and Renfrew moved forward Friday as the Ontario government announced it has issued a request for proposals (RFP) to design the widening of the busy corridor from two lanes to four.
